## Purpose

Apply the six imputation models to observed program adoption and summarize cumulative effects, county heterogeneity and associations with long-training intensity. Compare full and reliability-restricted samples.

```{r}
# Load the case-study panel, rebuild untreated labels, and configure history lags and the county adjacency graph.
dt <- readRDS("data/notpublic/compact_dt.rds") |> data.table()
dt$year |> summary()
dt$start_year |> table()

dt[, y0_25 := NULL]
dt[, y0 := NULL]
dt |> set_y0()
table(dt$year < dt$start_year, is.na(dt$y0))

load("data/W")
rownames(W) <- NULL
conf <- list(Lset = choose_lset(dt, shift_max = 3), graph = Matrix(W))
options(xpn.conf = conf)
```

======================================================================
FIT
======================================================================

```{r}
# Define a wrapper that fits one case-study model with 400 draws and saves its prediction rows.
fit_case <- function(
  fit_fun_case
  , nboot = 400
  , file_name = NULL
  , ...
) {
  fit <- dt |> fit_fun_case(nboot = nboot, ...)
  saveRDS(fit, paste0("data/case_study_", file_name, ".rds"))
}
```

```{r}
# Fit and save all six case-study models using observed adoption rather than placebo assignments.
fit_case(fit_fun_case = impute_xgb
  , file_name = "xgb"
  , ncores = 18
)

fit_case(fit_fun_case = impute_inla
  , fit_fun = fit_pm
  , file_name = "rw"
)

fit_case(fit_fun_case = impute_inla
  , fit_fun = fit_me
  , file_name = "rwi"
)

fit_case(fit_fun_case = impute_inla
  , fit_fun = fit_sptiv
  , file_name = "rwst"
)

fm_twfe <- formula(y0 ~ 1 | i + year)
fm_etwfe <- formula(y0 ~ 1 | start_year + year)

fit_case(fit_fun_case = impute_fe
  , fm = fm_twfe
  , file_name = "twfe"
)

fit_case(fit_fun_case = impute_fe
  , fm = fm_etwfe
  , file_name = "etwfe"
)
```

LOAD
======================================================================

```{r}
# Load saved case-study predictions, combine models and inspect missing posterior draws.
fit_files <- list.files("data/notpublic", "case_study_", full.names = TRUE)
fit_list  <- lapply(fit_files, readRDS)
# Name list elements with file basenames so rbindlist stores filenames in the id col
pnames <- basename(fit_files)
pnames <- gsub("\\.rds$", "", pnames)
pnames <- gsub("case_study_", "", pnames)
pnames
names(fit_list) <- pnames
# Combine and keep an id column (`sid`) with the source filename
fits <- rbindlist(fit_list, idcol = "model", fill = TRUE)
table(fits$model)
with(fits, tapply(is.na(y0_post_2), model, mean))
with(fits, tapply(is.na(y0_post_20), model, mean))
with(fits, tapply(is.na(y0_post_200), model, mean))
with(fits, tapply(is.na(y0_post_400), model, mean))
```

ADD OBS NOISE & CUMULATVE 
```{r}
# Compute pre-fit RMSE, add Poisson predictive noise and cumulate post-adoption outcomes/draws for years 0-4.
# Apply the pooled reliability rule, label models and save data/all_case_study.rds.
fits[, s := year - start_year]
fits <- fits[!is.na(y0_hat)]
fits[, nc := ordered(urb != "6.NonCore"
       , labels = c("NonCore", "All other counties")
     )]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Pre-period unit-by-model RMSE (your start, kept)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
unit_model_rmse <- fits[s < 0, .(
  rmse_pre = sqrt(mean((y - y0_hat)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
  n_pre = .N
), by = .(model, i)]
# Quick diagnostics
unit_model_rmse[, .(summary = list(summary(rmse_pre))), by = model]
unit_model_rmse[, .(q95 = quantile(rmse_pre, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)), by = model]

fits[unit_model_rmse, rmse_pre :=  i.rmse_pre, on = .(model, i)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# ------------------------------------------------------------


fits <- fits[s >= 0 & s <= 4]


draw_cols <- grep("^y0_post_", names(fits), value = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
#adding observational noise
# ------------------------------------------------------------
fits[, (draw_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(lam) rpois(.N, lam)),
     .SDcols = draw_cols]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create cumulative sums by i, ordered by event_time
# cumulative within unit
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fits[, c("n", "y", "y0_hat", draw_cols) := lapply(.SD, cumsum)
     , by = .(nc, model, i)
     , .SDcols = c("n", "y", "y0_hat", draw_cols)]

# If you need to set specific model names
order <- c("twfe", "etwfe", "rw", "rwi", "rwst", "xgb")
fits[, model := ordered(model, levels = order
       , labels = c("TWFE", "ETWFE", "RW", "RW-IID", "RW-ST", "GB-Ens")
     )]

#FILTER
fits[, rmse_pre_agg := median(rmse_pre)
     , by = .(i)]

fits[, keep := rmse_pre_agg < quantile(rmse_pre_agg, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)
     , by = .(nc)]

with(fits, tapply(keep, list(nc, model), \(x) mean(x)))


saveRDS(fits, "data/all_case_study.rds")
fits[i %in% 1:10, .(i, start_year, model, s, n, y, y0_hat, y0_post_1)]
```

```{r}
# Reload cumulative case-study predictions and replace untreated predictions/draws with effects y - y0.
# After this transformation, posterior columns represent cumulative effects rather than untreated outcomes.
fits <- readRDS("data/all_case_study.rds")



draw_cols <- grep("^y0_post_", names(fits), value = TRUE)
fits[
  , c("y0_hat", draw_cols) := lapply(.SD, \(x) as.numeric(y - x))# / n * 1e5)
  , .SDcols = c("y0_hat", draw_cols)
]


```




SUMMARY
```{r}
# Summarize draw-wise county-mean cumulative effects and 95% quantiles for full/restricted samples.
library(collapse)
model_colors <- c(
  "TWFE"    = "#1b9e77",
  "ETWFE"   = "#66c2a5",
  "RW"      = "#a6cee3",
  "RW-IID"  = "#1f78b4",
  "RW-ST"   = "#08306b",
  "GB-Ens"  = "#e69f00"
)
#average across counties for diffrent event times- and type of county
sum_tr <- fits[keep == TRUE, {
  mu_draw <- vapply(.SD, mean, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE)
  data.table(
    diff_y0_hat = mean(mu_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
    q025 = quantile(mu_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q975 = quantile(mu_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}, by = .(nc, s, model), .SDcols = draw_cols]

sum_tr[, sample := "Reliability-restricted (excludes top 10% pre-fit RMSE)"]
sum_all <- fits[, {
  mu_draw <- vapply(.SD, mean, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE)
  data.table(
    diff_y0_hat = mean(mu_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
    q025 = quantile(mu_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q975 = quantile(mu_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}, by = .(nc, s, model), .SDcols = draw_cols]
sum_all[, sample := "All"]

plot_dt <- rbind(sum_all, sum_tr, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# Plot and export noncore mean cumulative effects across horizons, models and sample variants.
case_plot <- plot_dt[nc == "NonCore"] |>
  ggplot(
    aes(x = s
      , y = diff_y0_hat, ymin = q025, ymax = q975
      , col = model
    )
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_grid(. ~ sample, scale = "free_y") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom") +
  #theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom") +
  ylab("cumulative effect") +
  xlab("years since the program started")

case_plot
png(paste0("results/figures/cum_effect_model.png")
  , width = 480 * 5, height = 480 * 2.5, res = 300
)
case_plot
dev.off()
```

***COUNTY-LEVEL EFFECTS***

IQR
given that there are some outliers, this is a robust measure of disperssion.
```{r}
# Compute draw-wise interquartile ranges of effects across counties as a robust heterogeneity measure.
# Summarize their posterior means and 95% quantiles for full/restricted samples.
#average over counties
iqr_all <- fits[
  , {
    iqr_draw <- vapply(.SD, IQR, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE)
    data.table(
      diff_y0_hat = mean(iqr_draw, na.rm = TRUE)
      , q025 = quantile(iqr_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
      , q975 = quantile(iqr_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }, by = .(nc, s, model),
  .SDcols = draw_cols
]
iqr_all[, sample := "All"]

iqr_tr <- fits[keep == TRUE
  , {
    iqr_draw <- vapply(.SD, IQR, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE)
    data.table(
      diff_y0_hat = mean(iqr_draw, na.rm = TRUE)
      , q025 = quantile(iqr_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
      , q975 = quantile(iqr_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }, by = .(nc, s, model),
  .SDcols = draw_cols
]

iqr_tr[, sample := "Reliability-restricted (excludes top 10% pre-fit RMSE)"]

iqr_dt <- rbind(iqr_all, iqr_tr, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# Plot and export noncore county-effect heterogeneity using the IQR summaries.
hetero_plot <- iqr_dt[nc == "NonCore"] |>

      , y = diff_y0_hat, ymin = q025, ymax = q975
      , col = model
    )
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +

  facet_wrap(~ sample, scale = "free_y") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom") +
  ylab("IQR of effect across counties") +
  xlab("years since the program started")

hetero_plot

png("results/figures/hetero_model.png"
  , width = 480 * 5, height = 480 * 2.5, res = 300
)
hetero_plot
dev.off()

```



LONG trainings?
```{r}
# Compute county mean long-training share and posterior Spearman correlations with cumulative effects.
# Summarize these associations for full/restricted samples and define a >0.75 training-share group.
fits[, mlong := fmean(long), by = i]
fits[, mlong20 := mlong > .75, by = i]
table(fits$mlong20)

cor_all <- fits[, {
  rho_draw <- vapply(
    .SD,
    \(y_draw) {
      cor(mlong, y_draw, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
    }, numeric(1)
  )
  data.table(
    est  = mean(rho_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
    q025 = quantile(rho_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q975 = quantile(rho_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}, by = .(nc, model, s), .SDcols = draw_cols]
cor_all[, sample := "All"]
cor_tr <- fits[keep == TRUE, {
  rho_draw <- vapply(
    .SD,
    \(y_draw) {
      cor(mlong, y_draw, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
    }, numeric(1)
  )
  data.table(
    est  = mean(rho_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
    q025 = quantile(rho_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q975 = quantile(rho_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}, by = .(nc, model, s), .SDcols = draw_cols]
cor_tr[, sample := "Reliability-restricted (excludes top 10% pre-fit RMSE)"]
cor_dt <- rbind(cor_all, cor_tr, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# Plot noncore training-effect correlations and export the correlation summary table.
cor_dt[nc == "NonCore"] |>

    )

cor_dt
```

```{r}
# Compare posterior mean cumulative effects for counties above/below the 0.75 long-training-share threshold.
# Plot the noncore comparison separately for full and reliability-restricted samples.
long_all <- fits[, {
  mu_draw <- vapply(.SD, mean, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE)
  data.table(
    diff_y0_hat = mean(mu_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
    q025 = quantile(mu_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q975 = quantile(mu_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}, by = .(mlong20, nc, s, model), .SDcols = draw_cols]
long_tr <- fits[keep == TRUE, {
  mu_draw <- vapply(.SD, mean, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE)
  data.table(
    diff_y0_hat = mean(mu_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
    q025 = quantile(mu_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q975 = quantile(mu_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}, by = .(mlong20, nc, s, model), .SDcols = draw_cols]
long_all[, sample := "All"]
long_tr[, sample := "Reliability-restricted (excludes top 10% pre-fit RMSE)"]
long_dt <- rbind(long_all, long_tr, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
long_dt <- long_dt[!is.na(mlong20)]


long_dt[nc == "NonCore"] |>
  ggplot(
    aes(x = s
      , y = diff_y0_hat, ymin = q025, ymax = q975
      , col = model
    )
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_grid(mlong20 ~ sample) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom") +
  ylab("cumulative effect") +
  xlab("years since the program started")


```
